shared_elements: curved incised lines suggesting drapery or hair
justification: Both are brown weathered stone monuments carved with an anthropomorphic subject and include circular disc/ring motifs, but A is a flat rectangular slab bearing a single crisply modelled head in strict profile with dense, controlled patterning of curls and beard, while B is a bulky freestanding three-dimensional block presenting a frontal, columnar figure whose motifs are shallow, eroded and schematic. Neither the format (plaque vs. monolith), the viewpoint (profile vs. frontal), nor the level of finish corresponds, so only the most generic features are shared.
